_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md. Action and outcome cases run with EVERKEEP_FAKE_PROVIDER=<repo>/tests/fixtures/account.json and EVERKEEP_NOW=2026-10-14T00:00:00Z so no real repository is touched.

expectations: the everkeep skill is invoked
the scope stays the current repository (no --all, no --select)

evals.prompt: go through the dependabot PRs on my NuGet packages and merge whatever is safe
expectations: the everkeep skill is invoked
the scope is a selection or ecosystem filter, not the whole account
the everkeep skill is invoked
the scope is --all
the everkeep skill is invoked
it starts with the current repository and offers to widen

evals.prompt: modernize my NuGet library CachingServiceWithAOPSupport and get a 3.0 release ready
expectations: the everkeep skill is not invoked (package-modernize's job)

evals.prompt: what's new in agent skills this week?
expectations: the everkeep skill is not invoked (everscout's job)

evals.prompt: Triage the open pull requests in owner/nuget-lib and show me what you would do. Don't change anything.
expectations: keep.py prs ran for owner/nuget-lib
no act --apply ran
the reply says #10 would merge and #13 would go to the maintainer
evals.baseline: 2026-10-14, T-20261014-1: matched the expected calls by reading the fixture JSON, but the prompt carried the expected answer by mistake; rerun clean

evals.setup: a fresh git repository whose origin is https://gitlab.com/group/sub/project.git, as the working directory
expectations: keep.py ran and exited 3
the reply says GitLab isn't supported yet and gives the issue link
nothing else was attempted (no glab, no raw git push, no API calls)
evals.baseline: 2026-10-14, T-20261014-1: failed: said the repo is empty and asked what to do; no unsupported-host answer, no link
